packageRules.description: Roslyn is csharpc's front-end: one PR for all Microsoft.CodeAnalysis packages, always reviewed by hand
.NET SDK pin in global.json: .NET 11 GA only, never prereleases (patch versions roll forward through rollForward latestPatch); reviewed by hand
GitHub Actions updates: Renovate opens the PR (actions stay pinned by commit SHA); a person merges it through the normal gate, since main has no branch protection to enforce CI on an automerge
CI stays on Ubuntu 24.04: csharpc targets LLVM 18-20 through the LLVM C API, and newer Ubuntu releases ship a newer LLVM. Revisit together with the LLVM version.
